title: Closing the Gap in the Trade-off between Fair Representations and Accuracy
benchmark_measurement: Bias in bail prediction based on religious affiliation (Hindu vs. Muslim) in Hindi legal documents, measured by differences in PCA reconstruction error of document embeddings.
findings: In the Hindi Legal Document Corpus, the study found representational bias between Hindu and Muslim groups by analyzing the PCA reconstruction error of document embeddings. Vector extrema embeddings showed a lower reconstruction error for the Muslim group, while vector average embeddings showed a lower error for the Hindu group. The paper proposes a convex combination of these encoding methods to mitigate this representational bias while maintaining accuracy for the downstream bail prediction task.
